reference_scope: The 2007-11-16 date is the verifiable initial public date of the earliest precisely date-stamped focal methodological reference, arXiv:0711.2585; the 1970 Chvátal graph paper is earlier, but no verified public day/month was available. The listed paper itself does not claim the evaluated magnetic census.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The result is an exact twelve-site zero-temperature census for three labeled colors, uniform positive antiferromagnetic bond penalty, and arbitrary one-color external field. It does not address thermodynamic limits. Two exhaustive standard-library implementations independently count all 531441 configurations; exact rational convex-envelope calculations prove every field regime. Full text of the 1970 graph article was inaccessible; a previously evaluated Chvátal Potts table may exist outside searched sources. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
title: Five magnetic coexistence fields and edge-selective frustration in the Chvátal Potts antiferromagnet
